# ScatterChart: reference lines and point clicks

- Files: `charts/ScatterChart.tsx`, `charts/ScatterChart.css`
- Change: `referenceLines` (dashed guides at fixed values, e.g. a 50% win
  rate; the axis range widens to include them) and `onPointClick` (click or
  Enter; on touch the first tap only shows the tooltip).
- Why: the Standard meta map links each archetype point to its page.
- Upstream: not submitted; carry it over when the file is re-copied from the registry.
